extracted_concepts.name: Vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A quantity with magnitude and direction, written v = ⟨a, b, c⟩.

extracted_concepts.name: Magnitude
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The length of a vector: |v| = √(a² + b² + c²).

extracted_concepts.name: Direction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The orientation of a vector in space.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector Addition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u + v = ⟨u₁+v₁, u₂+v₂, u₃+v₃⟩.

extracted_concepts.name: Scalar Multiplication
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: cv = ⟨ca, cb, cc⟩.

extracted_concepts.name: Dot Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u · v = u₁v₁ + u₂v₂ + u₃v₃ = |u||v|cos θ.

extracted_concepts.name: Cross Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u × v = ⟨u₂v₃-u₃v₂, u₃v₁-u₁v₃, u₁v₂-u₂v₁⟩.

extracted_concepts.name: Projection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The dot product measures projection.

extracted_concepts.name: Perpendicular Vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The cross product gives a perpendicular vector.

extracted_concepts.name: Function of Two Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function written z = f(x, y).

extracted_concepts.name: Partial Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a multivariable function with one variable held fixed.

extracted_concepts.name: Partial Derivative with Respect to x
aliases: partial derivative with respect to x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∂f/∂x = lim_{h→0} [f(x+h,y) - f(x,y)] / h.

extracted_concepts.name: Partial Derivative with Respect to y
aliases: partial derivative with respect to y
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∂f/∂y = lim_{h→0} [f(x,y+h) - f(x,y)] / h.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Used in the definition of partial derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Gradient
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: grad f = (∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y), pointing in the direction of steepest ascent.

extracted_concepts.name: Directional Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: D_u f = ∇f · u, the rate of change in a chosen direction.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit Direction Vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A vector of length 1 specifying direction.

extracted_concepts.name: Multivariable Chain Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dz/dt = ∂f/∂x · dx/dt + ∂f/∂y · dy/dt.

extracted_concepts.name: Lagrange Multipliers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Optimize f subject to g = 0 using ∇f = λ∇g.

extracted_concepts.name: Constraint Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A condition such as g(x, y) = 0 in constrained optimization.

extracted_concepts.name: Optimization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding maxima or minima of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Single-Variable Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiation of functions of one variable.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: How a quantity changes with respect to another.

extracted_concepts.name: Steepest Ascent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The direction in which a function increases fastest.

extracted_concepts.name: Multiple Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions depending on more than one variable.
